Please set the status of your contributions to WIP to allow for a proper review and necessary adjustments before the contributions are opened for approval by others.

Formatting
* Please study the formatting syntax described on this page: https://www.codingame.com/playgrounds/40701/help-center/statement , and format the statement properly following the example there.

Cover picture
* Please upload a cover picture for the puzzle.

I'll perform a more detailed review a bit later.

Thanks.

Below are additional points beyond those in my comment above:

Goal / Input / Constraints
* Consider renaming "grossIncome" to "profitBeforeTax" or "pretaxProfit" to avoid potential confusion. Gross income typically refers to revenue minus cost of sales, *before* operating costs.

Goal
* Consider removing "Do not count it twice". The preceding sentences already make it clear that the current year isn't represented in the historical data.

* The informal "sum" notation doesn't clearly specify which values to use in the formulas of [[yMean]] and [[m]]. Please rewrite them as follows (including the backticks):

[[yMean]] = arithmetic mean of [[y]] for the [[k]] years

```
        [[k]]
        ∑ ([[x]] - [[xMean]])([[yₓ]] - [[yMean]])
      [[x]]=1
[[m]] = ————————————————————————————————
        [[k]]
        ∑ ([[x]] - [[xMean]])²
      [[x]]=1
```

* With the formulas revised as above, the paragraph "Each sum covers all k historical statements. Using only the first and last statements is incorrect." could be removed. This would also eliminate the interruption between the forecast formula and the explanation of which x-values to use.

* Please add "([[k]] + 1)" after "The first forecast" to explicitly connect it to its corresponding x-value.

* Please replace "averageProjectedIncome" with "averageForecastIncome" for consistency, as "forecast" is used throughout the rest of the statement.

* Consider removing "It affects companyValue only; it must not change the forecasts or their average." The equations already define the calculation unambiguously.

* Please replace "below" with "in the Output section" for clarity.

* Please remove "All input is valid; no error handling or exception output is required." This is conventional here and doesn't need to be stated explicitly.

* Please remove the example, as it doesn't explain the calculations in much detail.

Input
* Please move the definitions of k and n back to the first input line.

* Please incorporate "All monetary… unit" into the description of "Next k lines".

Output
* Please remove "Print exactly five lines, without labels:".

* Consider removing the requirement to output Line 2, as the current-year income is already included on Line 3.

* Please remove "equal to the unrounded average forecast income divided by capitalizationRate" to avoid repeating the formula clearly defined in the Goal section.

* Please remove "Do not round intermediate calculations or use a rounded average to calculate the company value.", as this requirement is stated in the Goal section.

Constraints
* Please remove "grossIncome and taxes are integers", as this is specified in the Input section.

* Please remove "All input respects these constraints. Forecast incomes, their average, and the company value may be negative." The first sentence is redundant because the constraints define the permitted input domain. The second repeats information already stated in the Goal section.

Cases
* I'll review these later.

Thanks.
